title: Safety of Blood Stem Cell Mobilization With Plerixafor in Patients With Sickle Cell Disease
brief_summary: The objective of this study is to investigate if up to two injections of plerixafor represent a safe and effective strategy to mobilize adequate numbers of CD34+ hematopoietic stem progenitor cells (HSPC) for autologous hematopoietic cell transplantation (HCT) in sickle cell disease (SCD) patients
